Executive Summary
Introduction

This project focuses on developing a Task Management Web Application designed for individuals and small teams. The application aims to provide a simple yet scalable solution for task organization and management, built using modern web technologies and following real-world software engineering practices including planning, architecture design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

Problem Statement

Many individuals and small teams struggle to organize tasks efficiently due to existing tools being overly complex or costly. There is a need for a lightweight, easy-to-use task management system that provides essential functionality without unnecessary complexity or high costs.

Recommended Potential Solutions

The proposed solution is to build a three-tier web application using React for the frontend, Python FastAPI for the backend REST API, and PostgreSQL for data storage. The application will be containerized using Docker and deployed on a cloud platform with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments, ensuring scalability and maintainability.

Goals & objectives
  • Allow users to create, update, delete, and view tasks
  • Provide task status tracking (To Do, In Progress, Completed)
  • Ensure data persistence using a backend database
  • Design a scalable and maintainable architecture
  • Deploy the application to a cloud environment
Process Scope Summary
In Scope

The project scope encompasses the complete development lifecycle of a task management web application, including frontend development, backend API development, database design, basic authentication, comprehensive testing, and cloud deployment.

  • Frontend development using React
  • Backend REST API development using Python FastAPI
  • Database design and implementation using PostgreSQL
  • Basic user authentication system
  • Comprehensive testing strategy including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing
  • Cloud deployment using Docker containerization
  • Three-tier architecture implementation
Out of Scope

Advanced features and complex functionalities are excluded from the current version to maintain focus on core task management capabilities and ensure timely delivery of a functional application.

  • AI-based recommendations
  • Advanced analytics and reporting features
  • Complex workflow automation
  • Multi-tenant architecture
  • Advanced security features beyond basic authentication
